div.h2: Creating innovative windows and doors solutions for over 160 years

a.span: Explore Our Range of Quality Australian Made Products

div.h2: Products for the house of tomorrow, made today

a.span: Explore Our Range of Quality Australian Made Products

div.h2: Australia's preferred supplier of Windows and Doors

a.span: Explore Our Range of Quality Australian Made Products

div.h2: Products designed to perform, engineered to excel

a.span: Explore Our Range of Quality Australian Made Products

div.h2:
High performance you
can hear and see

a.span: Explore Our Range of Quality Australian Made Products

div.p: Architecturally inspired windows and doors. Check out our product range for more information.
Craft your own path by specifying the optimum choice for high performing windows and doors with cutting edge ‘must-see’ designs.
Provide a permanent impact and physical perimeter system on your windows and doors and achieve the ultimate in home safety and security.
Durable and minimalist window and door design that allows bountiful natural light and ventilation. Made for Australian residential homes.

div.class: section-home counter-section section-bg wow fadeIn rocket-lazyload

div.h2: Lifestyle-Enabling Windows Crafted to Fit Any Space
div.p: Custom made to your exact requirements with versatile configurations, so you get the best possible solution for your project every time.

div.h2: Bring the Outside in with Our Range of Quality Doors
div.p: Watch light-bathed living spaces come alive and experience glorious alfresco living at its finest. World class looks and thermal efficiency for the ultimate in-home comfort.

div.class: section-home quality-protection-section section-bg wow fadeIn rocket-lazyload

div.h2: Want Comfort and NCC 7+ Star Performance?
div.p: Get the Australian National Construction Code (NCC) 7+ star energy rating with our award winning, modern design and class leading performance range - ThermaLine®.

li.p: Fanastic customer service from Michael and the team at Traralgon branch Special thanks to Michael who privided excellent service and help with our window and doors order, great service from the team at Traralgon.

Excellent!! Been using dowell windows for a few years now and Louisa has been great to deal with. Always helpful and fast to respond. 100% recommend Lou Lou. The product is high quality for every application.

Finally after the lockdown has finished we were able to get our beautiful new windows installed. Here are our before and after photos of our doors. We are very happy with the difference the windows make, they really bring the outside in and allow so much more light into our living room. Dowell were very professional and their customer service was great.

Finally after the lockdown has finished we were able to get our beautiful new windows installed. Here are our before and after photos of our doors.
